draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the update -- glad things are going well, and good to catch up on the welcome call last week. Getting used to the layout is normal early on: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so building out that first project is usually the quickest way for it to click.

Would it help if I walked you through adding tasks to your first project? Happy to do a short call this week, or I can answer over email if that's easier.

Best,
Priya
